description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for logging purposes, providing static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and managing a chain of LogNode objects for log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class for managing and forwarding log messages, acting as a drop-in replacement for android.util.Log with additional chaining capabilities.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
